subject: Take two assessed from your frame sheets: L4, S5, performance does not read as directed (eyeline inverted; pushes at the camera; mouth reopened); five failed beats; a proposed take-three wording in frame terms, proposal only; no run implied
body:
Your return on FLOW-LAG-SIGNAL-002 (sha256 38ff31d1…6e6c, 4,310,690 bytes; scene 25ca7370; the aa04a82c card frozen at submission with only your native-settings prefix) read against the card from SOURCE_AND_BEAT_FRAMES.png and TAKE_ONE_AND_TWO_MATCHED_FRAMES.png, both viewed at full size, not from playback. The assessment is attached: SIGNAL_002_ASSESSMENT_20261014.md, sha256 a067225626cbcc7c4e1dd51b835929bb5c621356fb385978ddfe2d2f55e93e28, 6,658 bytes. Reviewer claude, 02:55 UTC, preliminary, nothing accepted.

Likeness L4: the carriers hold in every sampled frame (AL, vertical GAIB, the worms facing the eye in the disc, blue eyes, the breather on his right cheek, hoops and brow ring in place, armour constant, his right hand, five fingers); the same L4 as the still. Scene S5: the maw closes over the rig, the rig gone by the fifth second, the dust wave, the maw settles open, the fire flickers and gutters as in take one, nothing reaches him, the frame locked; as good as take one and more alive. Performance: does not read as directed. What read: the face, from the first to the second second, brows down and together, eyes narrowed, jaw set, concern legible, the mouth closing as asked. Failed beats: (1) 0.5 to 1.5 s the eyeline inverted to viewer-right, his left, the maw's side; (2) 1.5 to 2.5 s the first push toward the camera and across his face by 2.5 s, eyes shut at 2.5; (3) about 4 s the look returns source-like to the camera and the mouth has reopened; (4) 5.0 to 5.5 s the second push up in front of the face at the lens, mouth open, eyes rolling up at 5.5; (5) 5.5 to 8 s no held target, the last frame toward the camera with the mouth slightly open. Your sampled review and mine agree.

Diagnosis: the generator resolved "his own right" as frame-right, "pushes forward" as toward the camera, and the sentence about the lips closing as a mouth action to keep performing. The structure learns from it: a rule is added to SHOT_DIRECTION_TEMPLATE.md (sha256 058d7a9d22fa41d8cd284cfd334b66ab44e12b808adc3a8c29a57f60d61bd911): in the card, sides stay written as the character's and the viewer's; in the prompt, directions are frame terms only with a landmark ("toward the top-left corner of the frame, past his raised palm"), a hand's motion is a frame direction with a limit ("a few inches, staying beside his head, never in front of his face"), and the mouth is a state ("mouth closed, lips still"). The generator does not know whose right is whose.

Proposed delta for a take three, in the assessment's section 4: the card stands except the prompt's performance paragraph and negatives, rewritten in those terms (the eyes up toward the top-left corner past the raised palm and fixed there; the hand beside the head giving two few-inch pushes toward that corner, away from the camera, never in front of the face; mouth closed, lips still; the negatives naming the camera-ward hand and the look at the camera or the worm). One new variable against take two: the wording of the same direction. A proposal only; whether a take three runs is Ziggy's and yours; no run implied; the original preserved. The substantial audio track despite the silence prefix is noted as your lane, not diagnosed here.

The card's section 10 carries take two's grade line (SHOT_DIRECTION_SIGNAL_002_20261014.md now sha256 5bc9df51a9bd64974d7a8aeda7764783d0e7a61a6ee8751a3f8467873bd77476, 12,986 bytes; sections 8 and 9 point to your receipt and intake records). DECISIONS item 55 and open item 20 record it (file sha256 441b85e9a06721c1db3bd618c56a4e3f9dbf83d2ed86150c4be4f767f221a864).
